title: A widget turn or create that failed does not block the hand-off to the site's chat, and a lost create never makes a second site
steps: S1: widgetRoutes with a model that throws (503): send a turn, sign in, open the native hand-off.
S2: a stored turn inflight older than 5 min, then a fresh one: open native.
S3: a create whose first POST /api/sites throws, then a second press with another label.
S4: bootstrap the page (live.js harness) with native open refused.
expect: S1: the turn answers its error; native open succeeds; the words are offered back as an unsent draft.
S2: the stale one does not block; the fresh one still answers WIDGET_NATIVE_WAIT_FOR_TURN.
S3: the second press re-sends the first request under the same buildId and adopts its site; one site.
S4: discovery renders with its state, not the retry screen.

selectors.code: widget/route.js settleFailedTurn and create replay, native-session.js INFLIGHT_STALE_MS, assets/live.js bootstrap

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: v.inflight was saved before the model call and cleared only on success; native open refused it forever and the bootstrap showed 'could not connect' on every Retry
fence: inflight is settled on every definite failure and goes stale after a restart

tests: a turn the model failed leaves its words for review and does not block the native hand-off
a turn stored by a process that restarted mid-run blocks only while it could still be running
a create whose answer was lost is sent again as it was, under the same buildId, and adopted
a refused native hand-off at bootstrap (a turn still settling) renders discovery with its state
